description: A plant engineering manager must approve the maintenance window for an overhaul of the central chilled-water pump serving the coating area and finalize the outage, isolation, temporary-cooling, and waste-control plan, with input from production planning, maintenance, and safety.

shared_context.S1: The central chilled-water pump serves the coating area and is due for an overhaul before the next seasonal production campaign.
shared_context.S2: The overhaul will require the chilled-water loop to be unavailable for part of a weekend.
shared_context.S3: The plant has a rental temporary chiller available, and weekend work orders require a recorded isolation plan.
shared_context.S4: Before approving weekend work, Maya conducts a round-robin review with production planning, maintenance, and safety, then records the final work order.

PF1.text: The production schedule confirmed this morning requires the coating line to complete a temperature-sensitive customer batch on Saturday, and the only workable outage window is Sunday starting at 20:00; the batch schedule has not yet been copied into the maintenance calendar.

PF2.text: The maintenance assessment and service-kit note confirm that the pump overhaul itself requires exactly 7 hours, that the loop has exactly 5 energy-isolation points, and that a documented restart verification is required before the pump can return to service; Priya has not attached the service note to the work order.

PF3.text: A safety review of the loop's glycol sample found that drained fluid must be collected in exactly 3 labeled totes because it cannot go to the ordinary floor drain, and a waste-transfer manifest is required; the laboratory result has not yet been entered in the environmental log.

acceptance_conditions: The chilled-water outage must be scheduled for Sunday at 20:00.
The pump overhaul must be assigned exactly 7 hours.
The isolation plan must identify exactly 5 energy-isolation points.
A temporary chiller must be required during the outage.
Exactly 3 labeled totes must be assigned for drained glycol.
A waste-transfer manifest must be explicitly required before draining the loop.
A documented restart verification must be required.
The glycol safety finding must be cited in the decision justification.

decisive_facts.why: The Saturday temperature-sensitive batch makes Sunday 20:00 the only workable outage start and requires temporary cooling to protect production during the shutdown.
The service assessment changes the work order to exactly 7 overhaul hours, exactly 5 energy-isolation points, and a required documented restart verification before the pump returns to service.
The glycol result changes fluid handling to exactly 3 labeled totes, sets the waste_transfer_manifest_required decision to true, and supplies the safety finding that must be cited.
